defensives.name: Cloak of Shadows
defensives.usage_rule: Use to purge a dangerous magical debuff or to immune a targeted magical ability; must be used proactively since the 5-second window is very short.

defensives.name: Evasion
defensives.usage_rule: Use proactively before a burst of physical damage or during a physical tankbuster cleave; grants near-100% dodge for 10 seconds.

defensives.name: Crimson Vial
defensives.usage_rule: Use when health drops below 50% to restore a meaningful chunk of HP; short enough cooldown to use freely throughout the fight without holding for emergencies.

defensives.name: Feint
defensives.usage_rule: Press proactively before any telegraphed AoE damage event; its 15-second cooldown allows near-constant uptime during AoE-heavy phases.
